planItem: 77.44.7.A — Inspector background image lifecycle across all compatible PARTIAL types
finding: The media-backed background image field was registered on every PARTIAL Inspector type, but the end-to-end picker → Canvas → saved Page Model → separate Publish → public media renderer route was covered only by representative node types.
change: Added tests/browser/editor-inspector-background-image-partial-types.test.js and registered it in the editor browser suite. The real browser test creates all 45 current Inspector-compatible PARTIAL nodes (root plus 44 editable types), selects the asset through the actual shared media picker on each, then verifies authenticated Canvas preview, responsive command/key routing, draft-only Save, reload persistence, and separate public Publish.
lifecycle: All applicable nodes use the real Inspector media picker. Canvas resolves the selected asset through /api/admin/media?id=...; Save persists only the desktop Page Model override and leaves the public renderer unchanged; the draft selection survives Editor reload; explicit Publish copies the asset reference to the public snapshot and the public renderer resolves it through /media/<id>. Undo/Redo is verified on the final matrix node.
harnessNotes: The existing partial-type fixture provides required authored content; the new fixture follows the same content setup so Publish validates the actual Editor contract.
The modern root style capability must be enabled for the public root canvas to carry the root node's background asset; legacy root documents omit that public style projection by design.

reuseReview.solution: Reused the project's Property Registry, shared media picker, responsive command, Chromium fixture pattern, public renderer and existing Save/Publish model. No external implementation or dependency was introduced.
